<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—two dominant peaks separated by ~2 Da with nearly equal intensities (m/z ≈ 199 and ≈ 201)—the only common element that exhibits such a pattern is bromine (79Br/81Br ≈ 1:1). No other element shows this definitive signature, so the only element that can be confidently identified is Br.</thought>
<final_answer>['Br']</final_answer>
